product_repair.reason: The original seed43 eight-bit product run committed update15 with validation15 pending after an advance budget notice. Original endpoint remains censored. Repair the wrapper to complete scheduled validation, preserving real-signal preemption. No new final task-quality statistics were computed before this repair decision. Rerun both arms in all3seeds for a matched corrected endpoint, not just the favorable or failed arm.
product_repair.scope: Only actual390-second prepared product /2380-second composed cold-budget quality. Existing matched-update,60-second training, target timing and all original scores remain unchanged.

evaluation.historical_exposure: All32 eligible recording families outside repaired training/development were used in earlier final selections. Retain all32 prior questions and report both historical16-row subsets. Extra questions were chosen by metadata hash before new scores; they do not create unexposed recording families.

product_repair.recipe_and_statistical_procedure: Exactly the parent protocol: same mixed objective, LR,40-horizon schedule,max15,trainables,precision,clipping,data order,validation0/every5,checkpoint policy,128rows/32families,95%paired-seed and10000crossed-seed/recording bootstrap,RNG2026,all original thresholds.

gates.time_to_quality_target: 0.95 times paired fused initial validation NLL; unchanged prior criterion

product_repair.frozen_reference: Reuse verified original final-seed17/frozen: native core/model/input bytes unchanged. No new frozen selection or evaluation data.
product_repair.censoring: Every required validation at/before committed step must have completed. Score the exact committed checkpoint. Charge all setup,verification,validation,checkpoint,provenance and fresh scoring; over390seconds remains censored. Preserve all prior failures.
product_repair.historical_exposure: Authorized previously exposed pool; this correction repeats the same fixed comparison and is not independent replication.

report_scope: Corrected product endpoint; all other comparisons reuse the original locked campaign unchanged. Original product results remain separately preserved and censored.
